Internship – Digital Graphic Designer (6 to 12 months, starting March 2027)
Join the Digital Marketing team at Givaudan Fragrance & Beauty for 6 to 12 months and create social media content that grows the brand's awareness in targeted regions.
Givaudan is the global leader in creating fragrances and flavours. Our Fragrance & Beauty division creates fragrances for leading perfumery, beauty and personal care brands, and develops ingredients and actives for cosmetics.
Working alongside the Digital Marketing Manager, you will contribute to organic and paid campaigns rolled out by country and region on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and X.
This internship is about social media content, not branding: our brand identity already exists. Your job is to turn briefs into videos and visuals that perform, and to bring your own ideas.
Your missions
Your main mission: turn creative briefs into videos and visuals that follow the codes of each platform, for our organic and paid campaigns.
Video editing for social media : Reels, Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn videos, built from our footage and images. Vertical formats, a hook in the first seconds, pacing, subtitles and sounds adapted to each platform.
Understanding creative briefs : grasp the objective, audience and target region of a campaign, then suggest the format and angle that serve it best.
Organic and paid content : posts, carousels, stories and ad variations (LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads) in every format required.
Regional adaptation : adapt the same content to each market, language and platform, in line with Givaudan brand guidelines.
Creative proposals : come up with and drive your own ideas for formats and content, tested on our accounts.
Trend watch : follow what works on each platform and suggest how to adapt it to a premium B2B brand.
Your profile
You edit videos made for social media, you quickly understand a brief, and your curiosity drives you to make proposals.
Education and tools
You are studying graphic design, visual design, visual communication or motion design, and your school can sign a 6-12-month internship agreement.
You have already edited videos for social media, using Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or a similar tool.
You are proficient in Photoshop and Illustrator. Figma, InDesign or Canva are a plus.
Social media culture
You know the codes of each platform: formats, pacing, hooks, subtitles, trending sounds.
You can explain why a piece of content works, not just reproduce it.
You can tell a trend worth following from one that doesn't fit our image.
Soft skills
Curious: you take an interest in what you don't know yet, from ingredients to the markets we target.
You can read a creative brief, ask the right questions and come back with a proposal.
Fast and meticulous, you handle several requests at once and welcome feedback.
You work in English and French: much of our content and communication is in English.
An interest in fragrance, beauty or cosmetics is a real plus.
What we offer
A real first step into the working world: 6-12 months creating content that serves the business, with autonomy and constant support.
A voice in your projects : your ideas are heard, and part of the creativity in our content comes from you.
Supported autonomy : you take ownership of your content, with regular follow-up from the Digital Marketing Manager.
Real business understanding : you see how content serves an awareness goal in a region, from brief to results.
Varied projects : multi-country organic and paid campaigns, launches, trade shows and video series, in the world of perfumery.
At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.
We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.
Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.
Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.
